description: Register a voice clone from a short HTTPS audio URL or a local audio file path (requires explicit consent).

audioPath.description: Local file path of a short reference recording on this computer (.mp3, .wav, .m4a, or .webm, max 20MB). Send exactly one of audioUrl or audioPath.

audioUrl.description: HTTPS URL of a short reference recording (MP3, WAV, M4A, or WebM, max 20MB). Send exactly one of audioUrl or audioPath.

consent.description: Must be true: caller confirms consent to voice cloning

denoise.description: Clean background noise from the recording before cloning (recommended true; false for studio audio)

language.description: Language code for the clone — English only for now (e.g. en, en-us)

name: create_cloned_voice
